_comment: 相談の 練習の お客様 松本さんの お店（要望 #740・#741「松本店長の仕事がわかる背景」「松本店長を丸い領域で表示」）。1枚目は 人の いない お店の 背景（松本さんが 出る 場面で 使う）、2枚目は お店の カウンターに 立つ 松本さんの 胸から 上（丸く 切りぬいて 紹介に 使う）。
style: Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, warm daylight, contemporary Japan, kid-safe e-learning illustration. EMOTIONS ARE BIG AND OBVIOUS, like a Japanese comedy manga.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image: price tags and signs are blank colored shapes. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border.
negative: Never: realistic photo rendering, harsh gradients, six fingers, extra limbs, readable letters, dark horror tone, angry faces, real sadness or tears, costume changes, a drawn checkerboard pattern, grey hair, an old man.

scenes.title: お店（背景）
scenes.scene: Background only, no people. A small bright shop in Japan that sells computer accessories, seen from inside at eye level from standing height: wooden shelves and wall hooks with computer mice, USB desk lights, keyboards, cables and headphones in neat rows, small blank price tags, a wooden counter with a cash register and a laptop on the left, a glass shop door with warm daylight, potted plants, a dark green shop curtain. Clean, friendly and tidy. Keep the centre and the right third calm and less cluttered (a plain wall and a low shelf) so a standing character can be placed there later.

scenes.title: お店の 松本さん（丸い 紹介）
scenes.output: Output: one square illustration, 1024x1024. The character is centered, chest-up, with a little space above the head, so the picture can be cropped into a circle.
scenes.scene:
Character: お客様（お店の 店長） — Japanese-style anime character, man in his mid thirties, medium build, friendly upright posture. Short neat black hair with a soft side part. Kind dark brown eyes, warm friendly smile, clean-shaven. Outfit: dark green shop apron (#3E6B4F) with one front pocket and no writing on it, worn over a light blue checked button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, khaki chino trousers, brown leather shoes. No glasses, no hat.
Setting: inside his small computer-accessories shop (shelves with computer mice, USB desk lights and keyboards behind him, blank price tags), warm daylight.
Pose: standing behind the wooden shop counter, chest-up, facing the viewer, a warm welcoming smile, one hand resting on the counter next to a computer mouse on display.
